name: get
script:
set d to XMLOpen "$HTTP/files/simple.xml"
XMLTagName (XMLRoot d)
XMLURL d
XMLURL d with parent
XMLClose d

name: get-base
script:
set d to XMLOpen "$HTTP/files/simple.xml"
XMLBase d
XMLAbsoluteURL "other.xml" from d
XMLClose d

name: get-latin1
script:
set d to XMLOpen "$HTTP/files/latin1.xml"
XMLGetText (XMLRoot d)
XMLClose d

name: get-html
script:
set d to XMLOpen "$HTTP/files/page.html" with html4
XMLNodeInfo d
XMLClose d

name: get-query
script:
set d to XMLOpen "$HTTP/echo?a=1"
XMLDisplayXML (XMLRoot d)
XMLClose d

name: get-query-parameter
script:
set d to XMLOpen "$HTTP/echo" query "b=2&c=3"
XMLDisplayXML (XMLRoot d)
XMLClose d

name: get-query-both
script:
set d to XMLOpen "$HTTP/echo?a=1" query "b=2"
XMLDisplayXML (XMLRoot d)
XMLClose d

name: get-headers
post
script:
set d to XMLOpen "$HTTP/echo" query "b=2&c=3" with POST
XMLDisplayXML (XMLRoot d)
XMLClose d

name: post-no-query
script:
set d to XMLOpen "$HTTP/echo" with POST
XMLDisplayXML (XMLRoot d)
XMLClose d

name: post-headers
script:
set d to XMLOpen "$HTTP/echo" query "x=1" header {|X-Test|:"hello"} with POST
XMLDisplayXML (XMLRoot d)
XMLClose d
